name: Study plan · CST 2026 (from your Excel planner)
description: Your complete planner: Paper 1 and Paper 2 plan sheets (every topic with priority, hours, dates, status, revisions, confidence, tips), the tracker and the day-by-day calendar. Opens in the 📅 Study plan tab.

studyPlan.title: CST 2026 study plan
notes: 1. Every topic from both official syllabus PDFs is included. Paper-1 marks come from your official marks table. Paper-2 unit weights are ESTIMATES — the PDF gives no split.
2. Units 2–10 of Paper 2 closely follow the UGC-NET Computer Science syllabus, and the CST cadre has few past papers of its own. So UGC-NET CS previous-year MCQs are the best practice material.
3. Negative marking is not confirmed. One news source reports −0.25 per wrong answer; others say it is not stated. Check the official instructions or admit card before the exam.
4. Time budget: Mon–Fri ≈ 2.5 hrs after work (Paper 2 1.25 hrs + Paper 1 1.25 hrs). Sat–Sun ≈ 6.5 hrs (Paper 2 3.75 hrs + Paper 1 2.75 hrs). Plus 15 minutes of news every day for Current Affairs.
5. Phases: Learning 26-Sep → 6-Nov · Buffer 7–8 Nov · Revision + 3 full mocks per paper 9 → 22 Nov · Short-notes revision 23–26 Nov · Light day 27 Nov.

6. Your BE (CS/IS) background means Computer Literacy and parts of Paper 2 need less time. Kannada grammar & literature, Ed. Psychology and Value/Health Ed. get more time, since engineering doesn't cover them.
7. If you fall behind, use the 7–8 Nov buffer first, then cut Low-priority rows — never skip High-priority rows.
8. Once the exam date is announced, update cell B4 (yellow). All counters update automatically.
